title: Can You Have Diabetes With Normal Fasting Sugar?
description: Yes — 1 in 4 adults with early diabetes has normal fasting glucose but elevated A1C ≥5.7%; learn how to spot it and what to do next.
primaryKeyword: normal fasting sugar but high a1c

competitorCoverage: Top-ranking adult diabetes articles usually cover the basics: what diabetes is, common symptoms, who should be screened, and the main diagnostic thresholds for fasting glucose, A1c, and oral glucose tolerance testing. The strongest pages also explain risk factors, complications, and lifestyle changes for prevention/management, but many are broad and do not answer specific real-world scenarios like conflicting test results, borderline numbers, or when symptoms mean urgent evaluation.

title: A1C 5.7 at 50: What It Really Means
